title: Digital Marketing Agency in Orlando, FL
metaTitle: Digital Marketing Agency in Orlando, FL | TDM
metaDescription: Digital marketing for Orlando businesses: SEO, paid ads, social media, websites and video for the visitor economy and the city residents actually live in.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that helps Orlando businesses with SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Orlando hosts an enormous number of visitors for the theme parks and conventions, yet most local companies make their living from the people who live in Orange, Seminole and Osceola counties. We set up marketing that separates the two, so your budget is spent on the audience that can buy from you.

sections.heading: Two Orlandos: the resort corridor and the city
paragraphs: The tourist district runs along International Drive and out to Lake Buena Vista and Kissimmee. Walt Disney World, Universal Orlando and SeaWorld bring families from across the United States and abroad, and the Orange County Convention Center fills hotels with business travellers on a separate schedule. Restaurants, attractions, transport firms and vacation-home managers in this corridor sell to people who planned their trip months ago and will be gone within a week or two.

Residents live a different life in Winter Park, College Park, Thornton Park, Dr. Phillips, Lake Nona, Winter Garden, Altamonte Springs and Sanford. Many rarely go near the parks. The area keeps adding new households, and the economy they work in is broader than outsiders assume: a medical and life-sciences campus at Lake Nona, a long-established simulation and training industry near the University of Central Florida, defence contractors, construction and a great deal of healthcare.

This split causes a common and expensive mistake. An ad or a search campaign aimed at "Orlando" without care reaches tourists in hotel rooms who will never hire a local accountant, plumber or orthodontist.

sections.heading: Growth at the edges of the metro
paragraphs: Much of the region's growth is away from the old centre. Lake Nona to the southeast, Horizon West and Winter Garden to the west, and Kissimmee and St. Cloud in Osceola County have added large planned communities. People moving in look for a paediatrician, a pool service or a gym close to home, and established firms often have no page or business profile for the new area yet. We check where your customers live and the search data before recommending which areas to add.

sections.heading: What we do for an Orlando business
paragraphs: We start by deciding whether you serve visitors, residents or both, and build each side separately.
bullets: Location targeting that excludes the resort areas for resident services, or focuses on them for visitor businesses.
For visitor businesses: search visibility in the trip-planning phase and ads in the places your guests travel from.
For resident services: pages and Google profiles for the communities you cover, from Winter Park to Lake Nona and Kissimmee.
Campaign calendars set around school holidays, spring break, summer, the year-end holidays and major conventions.
Vertical video and photography for social feeds, where attractions and restaurants are discovered.
Reports that connect spend to bookings, calls and revenue.

sections.heading: Timing in a city that never fully slows down
paragraphs: Orlando has no true off-season, only shifts. School breaks bring families, convention weeks bring corporate travellers, and late summer is quieter and stormier. Residents follow the usual rhythm of a Florida city: air-conditioning repair peaks in the heat, roofing and tree work follow storms, and schools drive a rush each August. A marketing plan should have its content and budgets ready before each shift arrives.

cards.heading: Typical Orlando clients and what they need

items.title: Attractions and tours
items.text: Smaller attractions compete with the big parks for a day of a family's trip. Early search visibility and video win that day.

items.title: Vacation rentals
items.text: Homes around Kissimmee and Davenport need direct bookings. A fast site, good photos and targeted ads reduce reliance on listing platforms.

items.title: Restaurants
items.text: Visitors on International Drive and locals in Mills 50 or Winter Park search differently. Listings and content should match the crowd you serve.

items.title: Home services
items.text: New subdivisions bring demand for AC, pest control, pools and landscaping. Local search and call ads capture it.

items.title: Medical and dental practices
items.text: Growing suburbs mean patients choosing a provider for the first time. Reviews and clear treatment pages decide it.

items.title: Technology and training firms
items.text: Simulation, software and defence suppliers need credible websites and content that reaches procurement teams.

presence: A member of our team is based in Miami, elsewhere in Florida, so you can talk with someone who knows the state. Work for Orlando businesses is delivered remotely by our wider team, and any filming or product photography in a project is handled by our US-based team in the United States.

faqs.a: No. A member of our team is based in Miami, elsewhere in Florida, and we work with Orlando businesses remotely by call and shared reporting.

faqs.q: How do I stop my ads being shown to tourists?
faqs.a: With careful location settings. Ads can be limited to people who live in an area, and the resort districts can be excluded or bid down. We also choose search terms that residents use and visitors do not.

faqs.q: Can a local Orlando business benefit from convention traffic?
faqs.a: Some can. Restaurants, transport firms and event suppliers near International Drive see demand rise in convention weeks. Ads can be scheduled for those weeks and aimed at that area. Most resident services gain little from it.

faqs.q: How much does digital marketing cost in Orlando?
faqs.a: There is no fixed price. The figure depends on the channels you need, the content involved and how competitive your sector is. You get a quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: When is the best time to run campaigns for visitors?
faqs.a: Before they travel. Families tend to plan park trips well in advance, so campaigns should run during the planning period for each holiday season, with a smaller budget reaching people once they are in town.
